title: Above Average Fishing Charters
specs: Catch fish like grouper, snapper, hogfish, king mackerel, barracuda, and more depending on the season
Fish cleaning and display at dock for photos
Capacity is 6 persons max per boat
Private charters for up to 6; multiple boats for larger groups
Corporate outings and family reunions welcomed
includes: All licenses, ice, fuel, bait, tackle
Fish cleaning and filleting at end of trip
Cooler with ice for food and drinks (bring your own)
blurb: Above Average Fishing Charters offers fishing trips in Clearwater, Florida for anglers of all levels, with a six-person capacity per boat. All trips include licenses, bait, tackle, ice, and fuel. Guests can fish for species like grouper, snapper, king mackerel, and sharks (during the warmer months). Family and child friendly, trips can be tailored for special occasions or larger groups with multiple boats.
extraNote: If trip is cut short, refund for unused time (mentioned in review) · Shark Fishing available during the warmer months (Feb-Nov)
